card.fires_on: The "-g" piece right after P in P-gp or P-glycoprotein in drug interaction text. Also fires on odd letter pieces inside rare coined names and handles.

modes.label: P-gp term
modes.description: The "-g" after P in P-gp or P-glycoprotein substrate, inhibitor or inducer phrases.

modes.label: Rare coined names
modes.description: Letter pieces inside unusual names or code-like strings, including a drug antibody name and a language name.
modes.example: ANDEMBRY can prolong activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT) due to an interaction of garadacimab-g<<x>>ii with the aPTT assay.
